$comment: Machine-readable twin of CLAUDE.md > 'GitOps + self-heal' > 'Guarded exceptions to the no-write rule'. The default rule is that no session writes to the prod cluster; each entry here is a standing grant for ONE named operation under stated conditions, executed by the session through the named workflow and never as a raw command. tests/test_prod_write_exceptions.py fails if an entry and its workflow drift apart. Adding an entry is a real grant: it needs the owner's confirmation and a PR, exactly like governance/secret-provision-targets.json.

exceptions.operation: Delete a terminally-Failed kube-system/helm-install-traefik Job so the k3s helm-controller re-runs the chart. Nothing else.
exceptions.why_not_git: The Job belongs to k3s's helm-controller, not Argo, and the HelmChartConfig change that created it is already applied. A terminal Job is never retried, so no commit can clear it.
exceptions.evidence_required: mode=diagnose shows the Helm release status is 'deployed' (in-place upgrade). Any other status makes klipper-helm run 'helm uninstall --wait' first, which removes the ingress controller.
outside_grant: release status other than 'deployed' (failed, unknown, deleted, null)
any other Job, Deployment, Pod or resource
any invocation with accept_ingress_outage=true set by a session on its own initiative
exceptions.verify: kubectl -n kube-system get deploy traefik -o wide reaches 2/2 on the chart's target image
exceptions.rollback: none needed: a deleted Failed Job holds no state, and a failed retry leaves the previous release serving
